title: AKS Configuration and Secrets
description: Manage application configuration and secrets in AKS using ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Azure Key Vault integration.

data.text: Kubernetes separates configuration from container images using ConfigMaps (for non-sensitive data) and Secrets (for sensitive data). In production, integrate with Azure Key Vault for centralized secret management.
A ConfigMap stores key-value pairs or configuration files that your application reads at runtime. This allows you to change configuration without rebuilding the container image.

data.title: YAML - ConfigMap
data.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: "info"
  MAX_ITEMS: "100"
  feature-flags.json: |
    {"newUI": true, "beta": false}

data.text: Kubernetes Secrets store sensitive data like passwords, tokens, and certificates. Values are base64-encoded (not encrypted at rest by default), so encrypt etcd or use Azure Key Vault for sensitive production data.

data.title: YAML - Secret and Deployment Using It
data.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db-credentials
type: Opaque
stringData:
  connectionString: "Server=db;Database=app;User=admin;Password=s3cret!"
---
# In your Deployment spec:
    env:
    - name: ConnectionStrings__Default
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef:
          name: db-credentials
          key: connectionString

data.title: Azure Key Vault with AKS
data.text: For production workloads, use the Azure Key Vault Provider for Secrets Store CSI Driver. This mounts secrets directly from Key Vault as files on Pods, eliminating the need to store secrets in Kubernetes.

data.title: Azure CLI - Deploy Key Vault to AKS
data.content:
# Enable the Secrets Store CSI driver addon
az aks enable-addons --addons azure-keyvault-secrets-provider \
  --name myAKS --resource-group myRG

# Create a SecretProviderClass
apply -f secret-provider-class.yaml

terms.definition: A Kubernetes resource for storing non-sensitive configuration as key-value pairs.
A Kubernetes resource for storing sensitive data, base64-encoded.
Container Storage Interface driver - mounts Azure Key Vault secrets as files in Pods.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Secrets store sensitive data with base64 encoding
Use Azure Key Vault for production secrets in AKS
The CSI Driver mounts Key Vault secrets as files
data.takeaway: Keep configuration out of container images using ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Key Vault.
